author: Ozmori
quote: This is not review bombing, just an honest review, something many delusional fanboys are unable to do. I love GTA but this game is a mess: boring story & characters (especially the main character Jason), VERY bugged and totally overhyped. 30FPS is a joke, people made fun of nintendo fans for that and now suddenly they don't care anymore. Despite the low framerate, the graphics are great but that does not make up for all the other aspects. There are so many things to do in the game that are just completely unnecessary. Video games are for escapism and doing things you can't do irl. I'm not playing this to watch the paint dry on my walls or other redundant things. I want to steal cars and be a criminal, something I can't legally to in the real world. Going this far for "realism" only makes it less appealing as a video game. This game is a mess and not optimised at all. Also buying reviews is just everything wrong with the world. Every critic and GTA fanboy praising this as a 10/10 game is either lying to themselves (and others) or just completely delusional. This whole marketing with 10/10 reviews that start with "This is not a perfect game" just makes you doubt the honesty of any critics. It feels like Rockstar is being put on a pedastal and worshipped by a cult of fans that can't admit that the many, many years of waiting and hype was not worth it. Everyone is just saying this is the best game of all time and blatanly ignoring all the issues it has. I should give it a 0/0 tbh to cancel out some of the fake 10/10 reviews but as a fan of the series (at least in the past) it get's at least one point... At best, if you don't care about any of the negatives it is a 8/10. This is in no way GOTY worthy.
